responsibility: Declares the diagnostics, lints, and subdiagnostics used by HIR analysis to report semantic errors in lowered items, including associated-item resolution issues, generic-argument mismatches, trait and impl validity problems, delegation failures, and other analysis-specific user-facing messages.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `astconv/errors.rs`, this file is the broad diagnostics catalog for the whole crate, defining error and lint types used by later analysis phases such as checking, coherence, delegation, and trait validity rather than the AST-conversion routines themselves.
